instruction: Please enable the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC. I want all media files to open in the same VLC window instead of creating multiple instances.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
